_comment: P1-05 practical crew bounds. Back-solved crews from the target_days horizon produced mathematically valid but organisationally unrealistic 1-person 'isolated worker' crews on small projects. These bounds are construction-organisation defaults with NO field evidence: status is provisional and requires site_observed calibration before being read as fact.
provenance: No field evidence. A site trade is not realistically staffed by a single isolated worker; provisional default minimum is 2. by_activity_type is deliberately empty until calibrated — no per-trade minimum is invented.
calibration_rule: Replace defaults only with site_observed evidence; record basis and confirmed_by.
